subject: Request for temporary credits to preserve pilot usage
messages:
From: Katie Turner <katie.t@novapulse.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-25T09:12:00Z
Subject: Pilot at risk — procurement on hold, can we get short-term credits?

Hi Mina,

Quick note from our side — procurement at Novapulse has put a hard pause on new POs while legal finalizes a data annex. The pilot is mid-run and the engineering team is already using Redwood for inference experiments; if we lose access for more than a week we risk derailing the evaluation.

Is there any way Redwood can grant a short-term credit or top-up so we can keep the pilot running while procurement finishes the paperwork? We only need about two weeks. Happy to sign a simple acknowledgement and share the procurement ETA (they say ~10 business days).

Appreciate any help — this pilot is the clearest path to adoption for us.

Thanks,
Katie Turner
Director of Platform Engineering
Novapulse

Attachment: novapulse_po_intent.pdf (stub)
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Katie Turner <katie.t@novapulse.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-25T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot at risk — procurement on hold, can we get short-term credits?

Hi Katie — thanks for the heads up and the PO intent attachment. Sorry to hear procurement is slow here.

We can offer a short-term bridge: Redwood can apply a $1,500 credit to Novapulse's account to cover the next 14 days of pilot usage, conditional on procurement sharing a PO ETA and agreeing to a brief interim acknowledgement (I can send a one-paragraph doc). This is a one-time interim credit while procurement finalizes the contract.

If that works for you, I'll loop in our AE to approve the credit and will send the acknowledgement for signature. Please confirm the procurement contact and the expected PO submission window (10 business days is fine — we just need that cadence on record).

Thanks — we want to keep the engineers moving.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0193

Attachment: temporary-credit-approval.pdf (stub)
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-25T11:30:00Z
Subject: FW: Pilot at risk — procurement on hold, can we get short-term credits?

Marissa — fwd'ing Katie's ask. Novapulse is at the top of our 2027 pipeline list; infrastructure team is engaged and this pilot looks likely to convert if we avoid downtime. Mina suggests $1,500 for 14 days to preserve momentum.

Quick context: expected ARR if converted ~ $120k ARR, deal stage: pilot. Customer shared PO intent; procurement ETA ~10 business days.

Can you approve a one-time $1,500 bridge credit under our pilot accommodation playbook? If yes, we'll issue the credit and send a one-paragraph interim acknowledgement to the customer to sign.

Cheers,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-25T12:05:00Z
Subject: Re: FW: Pilot at risk — procurement on hold, can we get short-term credits?

Ben / Mina — approve $1,500 for 14 days to preserve the pilot. Condition: customer must sign our interim acknowledgement (one paragraph) and procurement must share PO ETA and procurement contact (email). Mark this as a manual promo (reason: procurement stall).

Please create a HubSpot note under deal NP-2027-042 and attach the interim acknowledgement. I'll flag this to Revenue Ops for reconciliation.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Related link: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deals/NP-2027-042
From: Katie Turner <katie.t@novapulse.com>

Thanks, Mina and team — that would help a lot. We accept the $1,500 credit for 14 days and will sign the interim acknowledgement. Procurement (procurement@novapulse.com) is now looped and estimates PO submission within 8–12 business days.

Procurement contact: Aaron Li <aaron.li@novapulse.com>. Aaron, we're requesting a short interim acknowledgement to accept a temporary credit to keep the pilot live; can you confirm PO timing?

I'll look out for the acknowledgement doc and will get it signed today from the engineering sponsor.

Best,
Katie Turner
Director of Platform Engineering
Novapulse
